produces_or_consumes_target: Neither is established by this pinned script. It defines a later binary zero-shot-v1.1 training pipeline from a foundation checkpoint by default, and its evaluation branch consumes a different base-size binary NLI checkpoint. The original large three-class target name and b354 revision do not occur. An optional commented large foundation model is not evidence of target production.

source_facts.fact: Loads prepared MoritzLaurer/dataset_train_nli, dataset_test_concat_nli and dataset_test_disaggregated_nli. None of these load_dataset calls pins revision or exact record identities.

Allows held-out task filtering. The all_except_nli list is mnli, anli, fevernli, wanli, lingnli; a separate branch adds mixtral_small_zeroshot. Shared dataset names do not establish original target lineage.

Training branch defaults to microsoft/deberta-v3-base and declares two labels: entailment and not_entailment. A comment offers other foundation choices, including large. This is not the original target large three-class producing-run manifest.
Evaluation branch loads MoritzLaurer/deberta-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli-ling-wanli-binary without revision. This is a different checkpoint from original large b354.
Prepared concatenated test data are used during the loop and disaggregated tests are separately evaluated. Exact test/selection/calibration records are not identified by this script.

Output repository template is MoritzLaurer/<model-base>-zeroshot-v1.1-<heldout>. Training uses3epochs, per-epoch evaluation, seed42, save_strategy=no. load_best_model_at_end and metric_for_best_model are commented out. The runtime producing invocation and resulting exact checkpoint are not supplied here.

Optional final upload targets the zero-shot-v1.1 repository template. A block for saving a best model is inside a triple-quoted inactive string. No original b354 upload or producing checkpoint is identified.
